title: Shard thousands of feet tall beside a Martian impact crater

tellings.quote: that's not a pyramid That's A Shard and it's thousands of feet tall

plain: A giant shard of rock or structure, thousands of feet tall, is said to stand beside an impact crater on Mars. Joe McMoneagle, a remote viewer who tries to describe distant places by mind alone, says he saw it in photo negatives from the mapping of Mars by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. "That's not a pyramid, that's a shard," he says, as part of his case that Mars once had life.
